Forta Exampleta: Fta1 == Vta1 || Fta1 == Vta2. Normallyta Llapan operatorsta areta interpretedta manta leftta man rightta. Qam canta Tikray theta orderta rayku placingta bracketsta. Forta Exampleta: Fta1 == Vta1 && ( Fta2 == Vta2 || Fta2 == Vta3 ). Alsota Qam canta Maskay textta K'anchakuna usingta regexta: Fta1 == /Testa.*/ita

Placingta ata `-` pi frontta pa *<field>* searchesta forta theta absenceta pa ata valueta pi thatta K'ancha (eta.gta. `hasta:-Tukuna` searchesta forta Tarjetakuna withoutta ata Tukuna Pacha).

globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Kay willaymi: Multipleta operatorsta mayta beta specifiedta.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Kay willaymi: Similarta operatorsta areta *ORta*edta togetherta.  Tarjetakuna thatta matchta anyta pa theta conditionsta willta beta returnedta.
`__operator_list__:Availableta __operator_list__:Blockedta` wouldta returnta Tarjetakuna containedta pi anyta Sinri namedta *Blockedta* orta *Availableta*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Kay willaymi: Differingta operatorsta areta *ANDta*edta togetherta.  Onlyta Tarjetakuna thatta matchta Llapan pa theta differingta operatorsta areta returnedta.  `__operator_list__:Availableta __operator_label__:redta` returnsta onlyta Tarjetakuna pi theta Sinri *Availableta* withta ata *redta* Unancha.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Kay willaymi: P'unchawkuna canta beta specifiedta asta ata positiveta orta negativeta integerta orta usingta `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` orta `__predicate_year__` forta theta Kunan periodta.
